method: Independent read-only review of the sanitized run and exact-hash acceptance result, development receipt/tree, inventory cases, runner, native panel harness, and trusted-input driver. No browser, build, or tests were run.

evidence.native_ui: Harness source proves the run launches Chrome-for-Testing with a new disposable profile, verifies the expected extension worker and SIDE_PANEL target, waits for a settled signed-out guest panel, and drives product actions through CDP pointer/keyboard input. Runner and harness contain no API/result stubs for these cases. Runtime observations are collected from the actual panel and worker; the two retained screenshots are harness captures, though not post-interaction screenshots.
evidence.exit: Sanitized run records processExitCode=0 and childExitCode=0 with no signal. No guardcleanexit-specific local log or receipt was found, so only these recorded exits are verified.

case_verdicts.basis: Warm and full-reload DOM observations from the guest panel show Advanced agent capabilities absent, advancedText=false, and no admin controls.

Real switch input changed persisted preference across reload and the coming-soon hint remained visible. This proves preference presentation/persistence only; it does not prove or claim deep-clean behavior executes.

Save is the trusted input boundary. The runner observes exactly one owned worker handler entry and post-probe availability broadcast after Save, both debugger pauses resume successfully, and the isolated selected port receives a health request. Valid/invalid/blank values and reload persistence are observed. The port deliberately returns 503; no healthy desktop connection is claimed.

Identity/readiness, observed no-update result, and reload criteria pass. API-unavailable, update-available, throttled, error, and update-API-unavailable branches are explicitly unverified and were not fabricated.

allowed_inventory_updates.detail: Real isolated Chrome-for-Testing signed-out guest; Advanced agent capabilities/admin controls absent warm and after reload; local development build 0.2.89 receipt/tree verified.
Visible coming-soon preference toggles, persists across reload, and is restored; this covers preference state only, not functional deep-clean behavior.

Valid Save triggers exactly one Save-bounded worker rediscovery entry/post-probe broadcast with successful debugger resumes; valid override persists, invalid range retains the saved value, blank clears override/error and remains cleared after reload. The isolated health probe returns 503; healthy desktop connectivity is not claimed.
Identity/readiness, real no-update outcome, and reload verified. Alternate API/update branches remain unverified.

open_questions: T70's explicitly unverified alternate API/update branches remain open; do not mark the full T70 case passing.
No guardcleanexit-specific log was available; sanitized process and Chrome child exit codes are both zero.
